test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following personalities received the Prestigious National Nritya Shiromani Award 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aparna Satheesan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National **Nritya Shiromani** award is given to outstanding dance performers and musicians of India and abroad for promoting and preserving the traditional classical art forms of India.** **
 
• **Aparna** was selected for her exceptional talent in the field of classical dance and for promoting the Kuchipudi dance across the globe.
 
• Celebrated dancer Aparna Satheesan, an exponent in** Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi.**
 
• Aparna’s performances are popular all over India and many other countries. 
 
• **Aparna Satheesan is a senior disciple of Guru Smt. Vyjayanthi Kashi has contributed tremendously to Bharatanatyam as well as Kuchipudi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karothi Venkata Satyanarayana,** better known as K. V. Satyanarayana is a Kuchipudi dancer, choreographer, dance director and composer in India. 
 
• He was born to Venkata Ramanamma and Guruvulu as Karothi Venkata Satyanarayana at Eluru.
 
• Sashindran is a versatile artist of the Kuchipudi dance style who has practised the art-form for close to four decades.
 
• Vedantam Ramalinga Sastry is an Indian classical dancer in Kuchipudi.
 
• He won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in **2012 for his research on Kuchipudi dance form.**
